content:
I knew from the teaser his design wasn't going to be anything crazy, although I do think it's growing on me. Ogier afterall is still a child, and this design's *incompleteness* works with that. Because it's still very much a genesis design even if simple. It reminds me a lot of bloodbath diablos from Monster Hunter.

My main issue is that there really isn't anything *defining* about him. At least bloodbath diablos have one giant horn. The torn body looks cool, but they could've gone harder with it. They could've at least given him a shoulder pad or make his devil arm more unique. I've seen some leaked concept art where he has dragons around him,but that appears to be more of his power. Maybe his exalt will be a devil trigger or something I don't know

Overall still above average for gacha, but for Morimens and a Genesis form at that it's a 6 or 7 out of 10 for me until I see the animations. A lot of things aren't as exaggerated as they could be
